label: ACCEPT
reason: Request DTO classes are named *Dto (DataDeletionDto, DataDeletionPreviewDto, GetFiltersDto, EventsDto); the only counted outlier, GetCustomEventMetadata in get-custom-event-meta.dto.ts, is an ordinary query DTO extending PickType(GetDataDto) that simply drops the suffix, a naming choice slip, while the @ValidatorConstraint companions in events.dto.ts are exempted by the rule itself. No naming-convention rule exists in backend/.oxlintrc.json, so nothing catches it.
